simple.meaning: יַחְצְאֵל (Yachtsᵉʼêl) is a Hebrew word meaning “Jachtseel , an Israelite.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: יַחְצְאֵל (H3183) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Genesis 46:24, with occurrences in Genesis, Numbers.

simple.summary: יַחְצְאֵל (Yachtsᵉʼêl) / H3183 is traced through Genesis 46:24, Numbers 26:48 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H3183. Yachtseel יַחְצִיאֵל יַחְצְאֵל, proper name, masculine ( God divideth, apportioneth ) — son of Naphtali; ׳יַחְצְ Gen 46:24 ( ᵐ5 Ασιηλ , ᵐ5 L Ιασνηλ ), Num 26:48 ( Σαηλ , Ασιηλ ) = ׳יַחֲצִי 1Chr 7:13 ( Ιεισιηλ , ᵐ5 L Ιασσιηλ ).

occurrences.englishText: The sons of Naphtali: Jahzeel, Guni, Jezer, and Shillem.
The sons of Naphtali after their families: of Jahzeel, the family of the Jahzeelites; of Guni, the family of the Gunites;
